items.title: 'Vibe Directing,' Hybrid Filmmaking and Robots: Disney's Startup Program Goes All-In on AI
items.excerpt: At Disney Accelerator Demo Day, the all-AI cohort, including AI-native studio Promise and OpenArt, showed 'vibe directing' and hybrid live-action/AI filmmaking tools.
items.rationale: New event (11-04): a major studio's accelerator demo day where every startup was AI-focused. It shows which filmmaking tools Disney is backing: vibe directing and hybrid live-action/AI production.

items.title: Weta FX and TAICCA Partner to Turn Taiwan Into an AI Screen Production Hub for Asia
items.excerpt: Weta FX and Taiwan's TAICCA will unveil a partnership at TCCF on Nov. 6 spanning co-investment, AI R&D and talent development, aiming to make Taiwan an AI screen-production hub for Asia.
items.rationale: New announcement: a top-tier VFX house teams with a national content agency on AI R&D and talent training. This is a production-pipeline story, not a funding round.

items.title: Seven directors to unveil AI short films at Seoul Independent Film Festival
items.excerpt: For SIFF's new 'AI Cinema Special' section, seven established directors including Lee Myung-se each teamed with AI creators (via Creative Mango) to make a short film. The shorts premiere when the festival opens Nov. 25.
items.rationale: New festival section that pairs established directors with AI creators, a concrete director-plus-AI collaboration model. Different event from the 11-04 Korean Academy of Arts / Im Kwon-taek AI film card.

items.title: Prompt, action, cut! Here comes Keralam's first full-length AI feature film
items.excerpt: 61-year-old first-time filmmaker Shane Sadanandan made the Malayalam feature 'Googilil Illaatha Oridam' entirely with AI tools, starting from Google Gemini prompt-writing, and is preparing its release.
items.rationale: A new film: a solo first-timer's all-AI Malayalam feature, which shows how low the barrier to an AI feature has become in regional cinema. Distinct from the Chinese and Japanese all-AI features already covered.
